notes.notes:

notes.title: Keyboard control
notes.notes:
Now, by default, the first player can be controlled with keyboard and mouse.

W, S, A, D - Forward, backward, left, right
Left mouse button - a Blow with the left hand
Right mouse button - a Blow with the Right hand
Middle mouse button - Kick leg
Space - Jump
F + left or right mouse button - Raise hands
C - Crouch

The plans to make the easy keyboard remap.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Kick is now the X button (on the joystick of the Xbox One was sticking). Fixed the bug with counting heads in the mode of football. The ball, after entering the gates will spawn in the center of the field.
